name: Architecture Workbench
tagline: A node-graph workbench that wires the studio's AI design tools into one whole-project pipeline.
description: An internal node-graph workbench, badged a local prototype, that lays out a 12-phase, whole-project pipeline where each node is one linked design tool (zoning, programme generation, massing options, pedestrian wind, solar and shadow, option comparison). A free-flow mode reveals a 272-contract system across 12 phases and 51 building typologies, each tagged by how much data-source coverage it has.

page.objective: See and wire the studio's separate design tools as one connected, whole-project pipeline instead of separate point tools.
page.problem: Each design tool in the stack (zoning, massing, wind, solar, and the rest) runs on its own, with no shared view of how a project moves between them.
page.solution: A node-graph lays every tool out as a stage in one pipeline, with a free-flow mode that expands the underlying contract and typology system behind it. It is explicitly badged a local prototype on its own screen.

highlights.headline: One node-graph connecting the studio's separate AI design tools into a single pipeline.
points: One pipeline, every tool — a 12-phase project pipeline where each node is a linked tool (zoning, programme, massing, wind, solar, comparison).
272-node design system — a free-flow view that expands into a 272-contract, 12-phase system.
Auto-expand site evidence — a site-intelligence pack that expands into OSM context, climate, rules, ecology, and utilities branches.
51 typologies, gap-tracked — a typology library of 51 building types, each tagged by data-source coverage.
